passive.name: Tailwind
passive.description:
Janna's allies gain Move Speed moving towards her.

Janna deals a portion of bonus Move Speed as bonus magic damage on hit and with Zephyr.

spells.name: Howling Gale
spells.description: By creating a localized change in pressure and temperature, Janna is able to create a small storm that grows in size with time. She can activate the spell again to release the storm. On release this storm will fly towards the direction it was cast in, dealing damage and knocking away any enemies in its path.
spells.tooltip: Janna summons a tornado that grows stronger over {{ maxduration }} seconds then blows along its path. It deals <magicDamage>{{ minimumdamage }} - {{ maxdamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Knocks Up</status> for {{ baseknockup }} - {{ maxknockup }} seconds. The distance, damage, and <status>Knock Up</status> duration increase based on how much the tornado grew. Janna can <recast>Recast</recast> to send the tornado early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Zephyr
spells.description: Janna summons an air elemental that passively increases her Move Speed and enables her to pass through units. She may also activate this ability to deal damage and slow an enemy's Move Speed.
spells.tooltip:
Passive: Janna gains {{ totalms }} Move Speed and is Ghosted.

Active: Janna's elemental strikes an enemy, Slowing them by {{ totalslow }} for {{ slowduration }} seconds, and dealing {{ totaldamage }} + {{ spell.tailwindself:bonusdamage }} magic damage.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Eye Of The Storm
spells.description: Janna conjures a defensive gale that shields an ally champion or turret from incoming damage and increases their Attack Damage.
spells.tooltip:
Janna grants an ally champion or turret {{ totalshield }} Shield for {{ shieldduration }} seconds. While shielded, they gain {{ totalad }} Attack Damage.

Janna refunds {{ ecdrefundforcc*100 }}% of the cooldown whenever she impairs an enemy champion's movement with an Ability.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Monsoon
spells.description: Janna surrounds herself in a magical storm, throwing enemies back. After the storm has settled, soothing winds heal nearby allies while the ability is active.
spells.tooltip: Janna summons a magical monsoon, <status>Knocking Back</status> nearby enemies then healing nearby allies for <healing>{{ totalheal }} Health</healing> over {{ duration }} seconds. Moving or using an Ability ends the monsoon early.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

variants.name: Tailwind
effects: Innate: Janna grants 6% bonus movement speed to nearby allied champions that are facing in the direction of her location.
Janna's basic attacks on-hit and Zephyr deal bonus magic damage equal to 30% of her bonus movement speed.

variants.name: Howling Gale
effects: Howling Gale can be recast at any time within the duration, and does so automatically after the duration.
Recast: Janna launches the whirlwind in the direction she targeted over 1.25 seconds, dealing magic damage to enemies hit and knocking them up for 0.5 : 1.25 (based on seconds charged) seconds.

variants.name: Eye of the Storm
effects: Passive: Whenever Janna's abilities slow or knock up at least one enemy champion, 20% of Eye of the Storm's cooldown is refunded. This may occur once per spell cast.

variants.name: Monsoon
effects: Active: Janna unleashes a blast that knocks back all nearby enemies to up to 875 units over 0.5 seconds based on their proximity, though not through terrain.
